spread_gate: positive supported spread; no upper cap; report <=2, (2,4], (4,8], >8 ticks separately
entry: P queue V5 primary, T 100ms taker secondary; unchanged source execution
exit: taker BBO including TAKE; unchanged source execution
weighting: uniform for every family; no episode-derived weighting
heads: binary fill/EMPTY and conditional TAKE/STOP/TIME fitted separately; both use decision-time X only
unknown: CENSORED/EXCLUDED/NOT_ELIGIBLE have unknown fill and path targets in this source; not converted to negatives
day_context: previous weekday same-contract session from London open through previous close plus current session prefix; today-London anchors separate; no skipping missing weekdays
context_price: available completed M1 decision-midpoints; volume-weighted midpoint proxy, not exact trade-price VWAP; observed extrema, not trade OHLC extrema

stft.support: 129 endpoints for 128 changes; all minutes valid and contiguous, no internal quote validity/epoch change, same quote segment; end publication <= decision; frame age <=90s

bootstrap.unit: daily sums on full calendar; conditional per-fill means also reported

admission: A2 lower 95% daily net bound >0 and >=30 fills, no censor; otherwise operational WAIT
policy: choose max expected net side at each root, enter only >0, busy until actual release, stop entire account at first selected unknown outcome
class_values: mean net per true class on fit months only
scene_selection: first supported February root in each spread bucket plus first TAKE/STOP/TIME/EMPTY/CENSORED candidate; no best-profit selection
scope: fixed representations and HGB; no recurrent full-day path model, no order-ID features, no post-entry X, no live admission claim
